text:
pam_g: Quick heads-up I opened a small PR to add a "Rate visibility" subsection to the quotas & pricing page. It explains how rate-limit headers map to the usage dashboard panels and gives a compact curl example for repro. PR: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/4999

ryan_c: 👍 nice idea. can we show how a short burst vs sustained load looks on the "requests by route" and "tokens by model" panels? a tiny annotated caption would help readers interpret spikes.

pam_g: added two captions and linked to a public grafana snapshot: https://grafana.public/redwood/snap/rate-visibility-2026. captions describe "burst (seconds)" vs "sustained (minutes)" shapes and recommended alert thresholds.

ethan_m: suggestion: call out "quota bleed" where many small requests can look like a single large spike in tokens. added a 2-line note and a micro example showing how to aggregate by x-redwood-quota-tenant in panels.

lara_docs: tiny nit: use lowercase header examples (`x-ratelimit-remaining`, `x-ratelimit-reset`, `x-redwood-quota-tenant`). also add one sentence that service tokens only may set quota attribution headers.

pam_g: updated headers and added the service-token caveat. included this compact curl snippet: 

```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $SERVICE_TOKEN" \
  -H "x-redwood-quota-tenant: team:beta" \
  -d '{"model":"open-7b","input":"Summarize..."}'
```

ryan_c: nice. also mention Dedicated pools return `x-redwood-dedicated-rate-*` headers and may have different per-unit economics. small line added?

pam_g: yup, added a short sentence with a link to the Dedicated pricing page and a note to contact account admin for exact values.

ethan_m: CI: please include a small pseudo-backoff snippet showing how to use `x-ratelimit-reset` to schedule retries. users forget to surface x-request-id.

pam_g: added a 3-line python example and a reminder to include `x-request-id` in support tickets.

lara_docs: editorial nit: avoid hard per-token cost numbers on public page. use "example estimates" and link to the internal costing sheet for exact math.

pam_g: adjusted wording to "example estimates" and added the link to the cost spreadsheet (internal). kept the public page free of absolute pricing.

docs-bot: docs PR #4999 lint check: markdown line-length warning on the curl block.

pam_g: wrapped lines and re-pushed.

docs-bot: docs PR #4999 passed (4 checks). merging shortly. :tada:
